project_summary: Robo-advisor web platform with automated portfolio rebalancing

components.name: Portfolio rebalancing service
components.description: Calculates drift against target allocations, proposes rebalancing orders with tax-loss harvesting rules and sends them to the broker API in batches.

components.name: Market data ingestion
components.description: Ingestion of end-of-day and intraday prices from two market data vendors, normalisation, gap detection and storage in a time-series table.

components.name: Investor dashboard
components.description: Web dashboard showing portfolio value, performance charts, allocation breakdown and pending orders, with responsive layout and accessibility support.

components.name: MiFID II regulatory reporting
components.description: Generation of suitability reports, cost and charges disclosures and transaction reports in the formats required by the financial regulator.
